An assistant gives you three answers for a report due today. All three sound sure.

Set how sure you are that each answer is true. Then check.

"The policy took effect in March."
"The policy covers contractors too."
"Section 4 was removed last year."

Confidence in your head should follow evidence, not the tone of the answer.

🎯
RememberA fluent answer is not a checked answer. Match your trust to the evidence.
